summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin handles the display logic for the staff admin welcome page, including site and discipline filtering, and login time display.
purpose: Provide an administrative interface for staff to view site and discipline data.

workflows.name: WelcomeStaffAdmin
steps: Load the session data for current staff.
Fill data dropdowns for site and discipline.

business_rules: SiteID and DisciplineID must be valid selections.
validations: Require valid date format for StartDate and EndDate.
conditions: Data is displayed based on discipline selected.
